sources.title: Multi — one task, the right AI workflow
sources.snippet: The unfair advantage Put 300+ AI models to work — the right one for every job. No single model wins at everything. Multi puts 300+ models from every major lab to work across four workflows, so you deploy the best AI for each task instead of forcing one to do it all. Using the right model for the right project is the advantage most people leave on the table.
